subject: Vendor onboarding docs - W-9 / EIN discrepancy for Horizon Medical
messages:
From: Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@horizonmed.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@horizonmed.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding docs for Redwood purchase account - W-9 and EIN note

Hi David,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. I uploaded our W-9 to the vendor portal but the system flagged the EIN as not matching the bank letter we also submitted. The two documents are for related entities within our group (Horizon Medical Holdings, Inc. and Horizon Medical, LLC) — same legal owner but separate EINs.

Attachments uploaded to the portal:
- W9_Horizon_Medical_scanned.pdf (W-9 for Horizon Medical, LLC)
- BankLetter_Notarized_2026-06-20.pdf (bank confirmation listing Horizon Medical Holdings, Inc.)

Can you confirm what evidence Redwood will accept so we can get POs unblocked? We can provide any of the following:
- IRS CP575 or EIN confirmation letter (we can request a reissue)
- Notarized bank letter that clearly maps subsidiary and tax ID
- DocuSign-signed W-9 by our CFO with a corporate resolution showing linkage

Our preference is to avoid long notary cycles — if DocuSign with a corporate resolution is acceptable, we can complete that today. Otherwise we will escalate for a CP575 request.

Thanks,
Tom Lewis
Director of Finance | Horizon Medical
procurement@horizonmed.com
Attachments: W9_Horizon_Medical_scanned.pdf, BankLetter_Notarized_2026-06-20.pdf

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@horizonmed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs for Redwood purchase account - W-9 and EIN note

Tom — thanks for the details and the uploads. Quick summary of where we are and next steps from our side: 

On Tue, 21 Sep 2026 at 09:13 Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@horizonmed.com> wrote:
> I uploaded our W-9 to the vendor portal but the system flagged the EIN as not matching the bank letter we also submitted.
> The two documents are for related entities within our group (Horizon Medical Holdings, Inc. and Horizon Medical, LLC) — same legal owner but separate EINs.

We need to confirm the legal payee entity that Redwood should use for the PO and payment routing. Options:
- If you want the PO against Horizon Medical, LLC (W-9 on file): provide a matching bank letter in that name OR a DocuSign W-9 signed by an authorized officer with an attached corporate resolution showing authority.
- If you want to bill under Horizon Medical Holdings, Inc. (bank letter name): provide a W-9 for that entity instead.

Kimberly / Ben — can we provisionally map the purchase account to the LLC for contract routing while we get the CP575 or resolution? If vendor provides DocuSign W-9 + resolution, can payments accept that as closing evidence?

Tom — if DocuSign + resolution is possible, please use the DocuSign link below and let us know which entity the invoices will come from. If you need an interim PO for onboarding work before full validation, state a preferred dollar cap for a conditional PO (we can issue a provisional PO and tag it for manual review).

DocuSign W-9 PowerForm: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123
Portal upload reference (for our team): https://redwood-internal/portal/uploads/7a9c2f

Cheers,
David Kim
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@horizonmed.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs for Redwood purchase account - W-9 and EIN note

David / Tom — quick payment-side note: we can accept any ONE of the following to clear the PO hold:

- IRS CP575 / EIN confirmation letter (preferred)
- Bank letter dated within last 12 months that shows the legal entity name matching the W-9 and an authorized banker signature (notarized is fine)
- DocuSign-signed W-9 by an officer + a corporate resolution or board minutes linking the officer to signing authority

If the vendor chooses DocuSign, please ensure:
- The signatory is listed in the corporate resolution/board minutes attached
- The name on the DocuSign envelope matches the W-9 name

If you cannot produce evidence by EOD Wednesday (our timezone), we can issue a conditional PO for up to $15,000 to allow onboarding work to begin; any larger amount will require CP575 or bank letter. 

Secure upload token (one-time): https://redwood-internal/portal/uploads/7a9c2f (use 'Sensitive Upload' option)

—Ben
Ben Carter
Payments Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

From: Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@horizonmed.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@horizonmed.com
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs for Redwood purchase account - W-9 and EIN note

Hi all — following up with closure: we completed the DocuSign W-9 (attached) and uploaded a notarized bank letter that explicitly lists Horizon Medical, LLC and references the holding company linkage. We also included a short corporate resolution confirming CFO signing authority. Links/attachments below: 

- Uploaded: W9_DocuSign_2026-09-23.pdf (DocuSign envelope completed by CFO)
- Uploaded: BankLetter_Notarized_2026-06-20.pdf (now includes explicit subsidiary mapping)
- Uploaded: Corporate_Resolution_HorizonSubsidiary.pdf

Per Ben's guidance, please proceed with PO issuance against Horizon Medical, LLC. If any follow-up is required for accounting reconciliation, let us know and we will provide the CP575 as a next step.

Thanks for the quick coordination — appreciate the workaround on the conditional PO while we gathered evidence.

Tom Lewis
Director of Finance | Horizon Medical
Attachments: W9_DocuSign_2026-09-23.pdf, BankLetter_Notarized_2026-06-20.pdf, Corporate_Resolution_HorizonSubsidiary.pdf
